Home / Checkout / Order received

Thanks, your order is in

We will email your confirmation and your order number shortly. Before anything is despatched we check the engine model against the rego or VIN you gave us, and we call you if it is not the model you ordered.

Your order has been received and our team has it. The itemised summary is only shown on the screen you are sent to straight after ordering, so it is not available on this page. Your confirmation email has the full details, and the workshop can confirm anything on (03) 8900 6005.

We confirm the engine model from your rego or VIN, usually the same business day.
We confirm the changeover arrangements for the return of your old engine.
Your engine is crated and freighted, or booked in for fitting at Hallam.
